items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: he used to send me on a lot of jobs. Well, they did think it was Chris that would be me playing.

ctx.x: Chris played a lot of parties, we used to have parties. People say there are parties on Monday nights at different places. At the house, the house party. Well they have four or five pieces.

Speaking of parties, we'll come back to your buddy McKee again in a minute if I think there's something to ask. Did you ever play many fish fries or lawn parties? Can you tell me anything about those?
